estimated_cost_policy: Peak noncached input 0.30 USD/M and output 1.20 USD/M; actual bills may be lower with cache or off-peak rates.
comparison_policy: Same role Prompts, generation, cases, labels, scorer checks, provider and shared conditional RiskInput policy. Dynamic mode additionally selects/skips context tasks and applies deterministic evidence/marker arbitration. Compare the whole orchestration bundle, not a pure concurrency ablation.
history_policy: Stage 1-5 files retained; original MODERATE risk labels on cb2-r03/r04 stay in the raw denominator. No output-guided Prompt or gold edits.

mock_fixture.interpretation: Synthetic I/O delay only; real latency is reported separately.
